# Wayforth

> Dedicated academic project, research report, and thesis advisory across undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral disciplines. 100% genuine human research, zero AI hallucination, and pay-as-you-go milestone trust.

Wayforth provides accessible, dependable academic research and project documentation support for students balancing rigorous academics with internships, technical ventures, and life beyond deadlines.

## Core Documentation

- [Home & Service Dossier](https://wayforth.in/): Primary web experience, 4 academic tiers, interactive exemplar specimen reader, and live mathematical quotation calculator.
- [Terms & Refund Policy](https://wayforth.in/terms): Official contractual governance, 7-step engagement workflow, and milestone refund terms.
- [Brand Asset Portal](https://wayforth.in/brand/index.html): Official vector logo package, 3D architectural monolith render, and WhatsApp Business assets.
- [Full Academic Context](https://wayforth.in/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive institutional guidelines, citation formats (APA, IEEE, Harvard, Chicago), and fee schedules.

## Optional

- [Robots Directives](https://wayforth.in/robots.txt): Search engine and AI bot crawler allowances.
- [XML Sitemap](https://wayforth.in/sitemap.xml): Complete URL index.
